verdict.rationale: A game engine editor could plausibly ship built-in AI assistance, so this axis applies, but the evidence shows no first-party AI feature that generates insights or suggestions inside Godot. The community MCP servers are third-party workarounds outside Godot's own distribution. The plugin and EditorScript APIs and the built-in GDScript LSP are developer building blocks, not the capability itself, so none of these earn credit.
